real_name_composite: The Resistance Front (TRF) — formed October 2019; operates as ISI's FATF-compliant deniable Kashmir proxy; leadership includes Sheikh Sajjad Gul (Pahalgam), Sajid Saifullah Jatt

real_life_notes.formation: TRF emerged weeks after Article 370 abrogation (August 5, 2019). Indian intelligence concluded it was created by ISI Directorate S as a clean-label front: no listed name on FATF watchlists, uses social media for recruitment, targets civilians not just security forces.
real_life_notes.pahalgam: TRF claimed the April 22, 2025 Pahalgam massacre (26 killed, mostly Hindu tourists). CCTV traced the cell to M4 carbines; the same arms pipeline was used in Reasi (June 2024).
real_life_notes.recruitment_model: TRF recruits post-Wani generation youth through social media (Telegram, Instagram) and WhatsApp groups — no physical madrassa pipeline. Operates leaderless cell model inspired by IS. Individual cells do not know other cells.
real_life_notes.jem_coordination: For high-complexity operations (Pahalgam, Reasi), TRF provides local knowledge and route intelligence while JeM provides trained Pakistani-national operatives. ISI provides weapons, funding, strategic authorisation.

objective: Execute high-visibility civilian attacks to undermine Article 370's perceived security gains; recruit post-Wani youth via social media; maintain operational tempo independent of FATF designation pressure; support ISI's two-front distraction strategy
oracle_threat_note: The Film 3-4 operational adversary on the ground in Kashmir. TRF is the delivery mechanism for ISI Kashmir Desk's strategic decisions. Its leaderless cell model makes it extremely resistant to penetration — Rizwan Shah's primary intelligence challenge is working back from individual cell members to the ISI handler chain.
